definition: Full-game model (lib/full-game-model.js) side agrees with Kalshi KXMLBGAME side; Kalshi confidence >= 0.62; model confidence >= 0.55.
policy: First fresh snapshot per game in the final 60 minutes before scheduled first pitch. Fixed 30-day collection, then wait for outcomes. No early promotion. Inconclusive if fewer than 100 graded marketTrust picks. No automatic rule changes.
